correct_completion: it presented a clear and convincing argument.
full_sentence: Although the essay was short, it presented a clear and convincing argument.
acceptable_variants: it still covered every major point.
it developed its main idea effectively.

options.text: so it was easy to read.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, not cause. This option expresses a result, which 'so' would show, not a contrast.

options.text: it presented a clear and convincing argument.

options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of length instead of providing the contrasting point expected after 'although'.

options.text: the writer used a lot of examples.
options.why_wrong: This adds information but does not contrast with the shortness mentioned in the first part of the sentence.

explanation: After 'although', the clause must express a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners often use a cause-and-result structure here, because in some languages a single connector can cover both meanings.
translation: Deneme kısa olmasına rağmen, açık ve ikna edici bir argüman sundu.
